packageRules.description: React and its types move together; split PRs would not build.
Tailwind 4 ships the engine and the PostCSS plugin in lockstep.
Type-only packages cannot change runtime behaviour; next build type-checks them.
Action bumps are verified by the workflows themselves.
Majors need a human: this repo has no test suite, so the only gate is the Vercel preview build.

SheetJS left the npm registry; the advisories have no fix there and never will. Build-time only (scripts/sync-scf.mjs, scripts/seed-csf-informative-refs.mjs), never shipped to a browser, and fed by files we choose. Revisit only as a migration to cdn.sheetjs.com.
